body:
Merged `origin/main` (6349a542e) into the branch. The branch also merges cleanly with 1d103b265. New head: `458e8be2eeecdda6cf0ee1a379df6c95985219b2` (merge 9b599e8da plus follow-up 458e8be2e). No rebase and no force-push.

Conflicting files and resolutions:
- `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs` (hand-merged logic): main's `cut_levels_under(top_z, approach.stock_top, ...)` ladder law (#2004) is kept. The PR's extra `ladder` stock argument is kept. The new `pocket3d_open_prev` of this PR also uses `cut_levels_under` now, not `cut_levels`. Its doc says it is `pocket3d_prev` move for move, and main changed `pocket3d_prev` to `cut_levels_under`. With no `stock_top`, the two laws give the same levels.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/mod.rs` and `raster.rs` (keep both): the PR side had committed CRLF line ends, which made a whole-file conflict. I normalised the PR side to LF and did a three-way merge. The merge was clean. Main's `mod rest`, the `rest` re-exports and `mod conservative` are kept.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/air_links.rs`: CRLF changed to LF. The content did not change.

Follow-up commit 458e8be2e (compile fixes after the merge, no logic change):
- `machining3d/descent.rs`: main's new `find_clear_helix` (c505b2ed3) uses `along_pass`, `lattice`, `disc_clears`, `dive_room` and `bore_meets_lifted_leg`. This PR had moved or stopped importing these items. I added the imports again. Main did not change the code that this PR moved to `descent_place.rs`.
- `crates/motion/tests/pocket3d_mask_edge.rs` (a new test from main): `open_sides` now takes `stock_band`. The calls pass `stock_band(r, false)`, which equals the old band `r - OPEN_SLACK`. No assertion, golden or pinned count changed.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` passed: 322 steps, 0 failed (wall time 61.7 min). The steps include all of the motion suites, the app lib and app suites (including `pocket3d_air_band`, `pocket3d_hsm`, `pocket3d_open_side`, `golden_cl`, `adaptive_fig8_crossing` and `top_z_stock_over`) and the ui suites. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

The first gate run stopped because of the compile errors above. A second run was killed by a shell timeout during the app build, which the gate reported as a compile error. A plain `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run --tests` built without errors.

This is a DELTA refresh (hunks resolved by hand), so it needs a delta review. The work is under the safety floor.

ready for a re-check

Quick pass on head `458e8be2e`: the PR merges cleanly with `main`. The author's quick gate is green on this head (322 steps, 0 failed, with `golden_cl`, `top_z_stock_over` and the `pocket3d_*` suites). The refresh comment names the hand-merged hunks. I flag the PR ready for a delta review under the safety floor.
